title: EvidenceTreeAdapter
responsibility: Builds commits on a Git ref from blobs with plumbing, without a working tree, updating the ref only if it has not moved.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Root value handed to GitAdapter, which the adapter's methods use through this.git for their Git commands. The constructor only assigns the new GitAdapter to this.git and does not validate the value.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.tip.ref
inputs.description: Ref or revision that tip resolves with rev-parse, such as refs/heads/main. tip appends ^{commit} to it, so the value must name an object that peels to a commit.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.contains.descendant
inputs.description: Commit whose history is checked for ancestor. contains returns true only when ancestor is descendant itself or one of its ancestors, and both commits are present.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.contains.ancestor
inputs.description: Commit that contains looks for in the history of descendant, where descendant itself also counts as a match. A value that is not a present commit makes contains return false.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.exists.commit
inputs.description: Object name to test, which counts as a commit only when it peels to one in this repository. An unknown name or any failed check makes exists return false.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.read.commit
inputs.description: Commit whose tree holds the file, used as commit:path in the Git lookup. read returns undefined when the commit or the path is absent.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.read.path
inputs.description: Repository path of the file inside that commit's tree, which read appends to the commit as commit:path, so it is not a disk path. A path with no file at that location in the commit makes read return undefined.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.readMany.commit
inputs.description: Commit from which requested raw blobs are read. Only requested paths are enumerated through bounded literal pathspec batches before unique object hashes are read in bounded blob batches.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.readMany.paths
inputs.description: Exact repository paths to read from the commit, and a path missing from the listing is left out of the result. An empty array returns an empty Map before the commit is listed.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.list.commit
inputs.description: Commit whose blobs are enumerated, recursively within supplied literal paths or throughout the tree when paths is omitted. Non-blob entries are skipped and blob sizes are recorded for later readMany batches.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.list.paths
inputs.description: Omit to list every blob. Supply literal repository-relative files or directories to enumerate only those paths and directory descendants; an empty array returns an empty map without invoking Git. Names retain their complete repository-relative paths, and wildcard characters are literal. Only selected blob sizes are remembered. Duplicate paths are coalesced and scoped Git queries use weighted 32KiB argument batches, so large manifests do not become one oversized process argument list. A single path plus the 128-byte per-argument allowance must fit the 32KiB budget; oversized names reject with Error.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.commit.input
inputs.description: Commit to create: a parent list, the files to add on top of the first parent's tree, and a message; with no parents the tree starts empty. The commit is created without moving any ref, so advance is the separate call that moves one.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.advance.ref
inputs.description: Ref that advance moves, such as refs/heads/evidence. The move happens only if the ref still holds expected.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.advance.next
inputs.description: Commit id that the ref is set to when the move succeeds. advance passes it to update-ref without checking it first.

inputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.advance.expected
inputs.description: Commit id the ref must still hold for the move to happen. undefined is sent as the all-zero id, which asks update-ref to move the ref only when it does not exist yet.

inputs.name: batchBufferBytes.sizes
inputs.description: Byte size of each blob in one batch read. The result adds 128 bytes of room per blob for its header line and trailing newline, and an empty list gives 1.

inputs.name: batchGroups.hashes
inputs.description: Blob ids to split into groups, kept in the order given. Each id's size comes from sizes, and an id with no entry there counts as 0 bytes.

inputs.name: batchGroups.sizes
inputs.description: Map from blob id to byte size, the sizes that list records for readMany's batch reads. A hash with no entry counts as 0 bytes.

inputs.name: batchGroups.ceiling
inputs.description: Largest output buffer size in bytes that one group may need, as measured by batchBufferBytes. A hash that would push its group past the ceiling starts a new group, and a single hash always forms a group even when it alone is larger.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.tip
outputs.description: Full commit id that the ref resolves to, or undefined when the ref names no commit.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.contains
outputs.description: True when ancestor is descendant itself or one of its ancestors and both are present; false otherwise, including when the Git check exits with a non-zero code.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.exists
outputs.description: True when the name peels to a commit in this repository; false when the cat-file check exits with a non-zero code.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.read
outputs.description: Raw bytes of the file at the requested commit and path, returned as a Buffer, or undefined when the commit or the path is absent. The output limit is sized from the file's reported size, so a large file is not cut off by the adapter's default output cap.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.readMany
outputs.description: Map from each requested path that the commit contains to a copy of its raw bytes as a Buffer. Missing paths are left out, and a blob shared by several paths is read only once.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.list
outputs.description: Map from the complete repository-relative path of each selected blob to its blob id. Omitted paths select the whole tree; supplied files/directories limit enumeration, empty paths select nothing, and non-blob entries are absent.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.commit
outputs.description: Object id of the new commit that commit-tree created. commit itself moves no ref.

outputs.name: EvidenceTreeAdapter.advance
outputs.description: True when the ref was moved to next; false when update-ref exits with a non-zero code, which the adapter documents as someone else having moved the ref first.

outputs.name: batchBufferBytes
outputs.description: Output buffer size in bytes for one batch read: the sum of each size plus 128 bytes, and never less than 1.

outputs.name: batchGroups
outputs.description: Groups of the input hashes in the order given, each cut so that its batch output stays within the ceiling unless a single hash is larger on its own. An empty input gives an empty array.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown as 'Invalid Git batch response' by readMany when its cat-file --batch output is malformed; errors from the Git, temporary-directory and commitIdentity calls in list, readMany and commit reach the caller unchanged.
